collection.title: Citroen Xsara Estate 1997 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Citroen Xsara Estate 1997 to 2010 model requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also have the rear blade for this Xsara, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
